commands.title: Run in background
commands.description: First line: run this script in the background.

commands.title: Hold a key while the pad is held
commands.description: Hold a key while its Launchpad pad or demo mouse button is held.

commands.title: Load another layout
commands.description: First line: load a layout from user_layouts.

commands.title: Type text
commands.description: Type the text following the command.

commands.title: Wait
commands.description: Wait. The unit is seconds, including fractional values.

commands.title: Tap a key or mouse button
commands.description: Press and release a key, optionally repeating it.

commands.title: Hold down a key or mouse button
commands.description: Hold a key until RELEASE or RELEASE_ALL.

commands.title: Release a key or mouse button
commands.description: Release a held key.

commands.title: Release all held keys
commands.description: Release all keys held by scripts.

commands.title: Open a website
commands.description: Open a website in your browser.

commands.title: Open a website in a new window
commands.description: Ask the browser to open a new window.

commands.title: Run a program
commands.description: Run an external program. Use an executable path; OS-specific commands need adapting.

commands.title: Open a file or folder
commands.description: Open a file or folder with its default application.

commands.title: Play a sound effect

fields.name: path
fields.label: Audio file (no spaces for this legacy command)

commands.description: Play a one-shot effect from user_sounds. Volume is 0–100.

commands.title: Play / pause a soundtrack
commands.description: One pad toggles play/pause/resume. Enter fade times in seconds here. Pause preserves the playhead. Track files are relative to user_sounds.

commands.title: Pause all soundtracks
commands.description: Pause all soundtrack pads, on every page. Leave the fade time blank to use each track’s pause fade.

commands.title: Resume all paused soundtracks
commands.description: Continue paused soundtracks at their saved positions. Uses each play fade unless overridden.

commands.title: Stop all audio
commands.description: Stop all audio. A later play starts from the beginning. Optional fade is milliseconds.

commands.title: Skip forward / backward
commands.description: Skip forward or backward. Without coordinates, affects all active tracks. With coordinates, targets that pad on this page. Paused tracks stay paused.

commands.title: Jump to a track position
commands.description: Jump to an absolute time, in seconds. Optional pad coordinates target this page; otherwise affects all active tracks.

commands.title: Wait until this pad is released
commands.description: Wait until this pad is released.

commands.title: Move the pointer by an offset
commands.description: Move the pointer relative to its current position.

commands.title: Move the pointer to a position
commands.description: Move the pointer to screen coordinates.

commands.title: Scroll
commands.description: Scroll the wheel; negative values reverse direction.

commands.title: Move the pointer along a line
commands.description: Move along a line between two screen points.

commands.title: Move the pointer along a relative line
commands.description: Move along a line relative to the current pointer.

commands.title: Move in a line to a position
commands.description: Move in a line to an absolute point.

commands.title: Remember the pointer position
commands.description: Remember the current pointer location in this script.

commands.title: Return to the remembered pointer position
commands.description: Return to the location saved by M_STORE.

commands.title: Move in a line to the remembered position
commands.description: Return to the stored pointer location along a line.

commands.title: Name a point in this sequence
commands.description: Define a jump/repeat label.

commands.title: Jump to a named point
commands.description: Jump to a label in this script.

commands.title: Jump while this pad is held
commands.description: Jump if this pad is still held.

commands.title: Jump when this pad is released
commands.description: Jump if this pad is released.

commands.title: Repeat from a named point
commands.description: Repeat a label a limited number of times.

commands.title: Repeat while this pad is held
commands.description: Repeat while the pad is held, up to count times.

commands.title: Repeat when this pad is released
commands.description: Repeat while released, up to count times.

commands.title: Reset repeat counters
commands.description: Reset this script’s repeat counters.

commands.title: Switch to a page
commands.description: Switch to a page by name or 1-based number. Background tracks keep playing.

commands.title: Go to the next page
commands.description: Switch to the next page, wrapping at the end.

commands.title: Go to the previous page
commands.description: Switch to the previous page.

commands.title: Comment / note
commands.description: A note for yourself; it does not run anything.
